title: Local well-posedness for nonlinear Dirac equation on $N$-star metric graphs
summary: We consider the Cauchy problem for the nonlinear Dirac equation on a noncompact $N$-star metric graph $G$, \[ \mathrm{i}\partial_t ψ= Dψ- |ψ|^{p-2}ψ, \qquad ψ(0)=ψ_0, \] where $p\ge3$, $ψ:\mathbb{R}\times G\to\mathbb{C}^2$ and $D$ denotes the self-adjoint Dirac-Kirchhoff operator on $G$.
